phase: Phase 23: Automated Multi-Path Mesh Failover & Hybrid Cellular/SFU Relay Handover

stories.title: Pure KMP Multi-Path Link Quality Arbiter & Automated Failover State Machine
stories.description: Implement FailoverModels.kt and MultiPathFailoverArbiter.kt in app/sharedLogic/src/commonMain/kotlin/org/nowni/intercom_alpha/mesh/failover/. Evaluates link delivery metrics (ETX, RSSI, heartbeat timeout, packet loss ratio). Manages discrete handover states (BLE_DIRECT, MULTI_PATH_HEDGED, CLOUD_RELAY_ONLY, RESTRICTED_OFFLINE) with configurable hysteresis (e.g., 5,000ms stable BLE before de-escalating from cloud to avoid handover flapping). Pure Kotlin with zero Java/C dependencies (Rules 2 & 3).
acceptanceCriteria: Pure KMP implementation with zero Java, C, or platform-specific dependencies in commonMain (Rules 2 & 3)
Defines FailoverMode (BLE_DIRECT, MULTI_PATH_HEDGED, CLOUD_RELAY_ONLY, RESTRICTED_OFFLINE)
Transitions from BLE_DIRECT to MULTI_PATH_HEDGED when link quality drops below threshold (ETX > 2.5 or loss > 20%)
Transitions to CLOUD_RELAY_ONLY upon complete BLE link break (timeout > 4,000ms)
Implements hysteresis timer preventing rapid oscillation/flutter between modes
100% unit test pass across JVM, Android, and iOS Simulator targets

stories.title: Transport Handover Wire Integration & Seamless Voice Stream Hedging
stories.description: Implement HybridTransportRouter.kt and integrate with CloudRelayBridge.kt and MeshTransport.kt. Intercepts outbound MeshPacket.Audio and MeshPacket.Control to route across BLE and/or Ktor WebSocket cloud relay according to the active FailoverMode. In MULTI_PATH_HEDGED mode, dual-casts critical voice frames over both transports with sequence synchronization, while receiver-side PacketDeduplicator transparently suppresses duplicates, ensuring zero dropped audio frames during RF boundary transitions.
acceptanceCriteria: Routes packets dynamically across BLE and Cloud transports according to FailoverMode
In MULTI_PATH_HEDGED mode, hedges voice frames across both transports with zero audio packet loss
Maintains sequence synchronization and coordinates with PacketDeduplicator to prevent duplicate playback
Integrates with MeshQoSScheduler so hedged voice frames retain top priority
100% unit test pass across JVM, Android, and iOS Simulator targets

stories.title: Subsystem Hardware Bridge Wiring & Multiplatform Tactical Transport Handover HUD Presentation
stories.description: Wire MultiPathFailoverArbiter and HybridTransportRouter into IntercomHardwareBridge, AndroidPlatformBridge, IntercomBridge (iosMain) with typed CancellationHandle observers, and register singletons in AppModule.kt. Expose reactive failoverSnapshot flow. Present tactical transport status indicator badge (BLE / HEDGED / CLOUD / OFFLINE) and handover diagnostic sheet in Compose Multiplatform (HomeScreen.kt) and 100% Native iOS SwiftUI (ContentView.swift / IntercomViewModel.swift respecting Rule 1).
acceptanceCriteria: Hardware bridges expose failoverSnapshot flow and reactive CancellationHandle observers for iOS (Rule 1)
AppModule registers all required singletons in Koin DI container without runtime missing definition exceptions
Compose Multiplatform displays tactical transport status pill and handover transition banner
100% Native iOS SwiftUI displays tactical transport pill in TacticalAvionicsBar (Rule 1)
Full compilation and automated verification pass across all targets

stories.title: Highway Convoy Out-of-Range Handover Simulation Harness & Archify Showcase Update
stories.description: Implement MultiPathHandoverSimulationHarness.kt simulating a 16-node convoy highway split scenario where a tail group drifts out of BLE line-of-sight, hedges across cellular SFU relay, traverses a zero-connectivity dead zone, and seamlessly rejoins the primary BLE mesh. Validates zero audio dropout during handover and proper hysteresis dampening. Update Archify interactive architecture specifications to showcase quality.
acceptanceCriteria: Simulates multi-node convoy drift, RF degradation, cloud handover, and re-entry hysteresis
Verifies 0% audio frame loss during active speech during BLE-to-Cloud transition
Validates hysteresis dampening prevents oscillation under fluctuating RSSI
Archify architecture specification and HTML showcase updated with 9/9 verification pass
Full multiplatform test suite pass across all targets
